BOOK ONE · LESSON 141

Sally's first train ride

萨莉第一次乘火车旅行

A story lesson about Sally's first train ride. Last week, the narrator's four-year-old daughter Sally was invited to a children's party, and the narrator decided to take her by train. Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before. She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw. A pretty lady got on the train and sat near Sally, wearing a blue dress and a large, fashionable hat. After the train had reached the next station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her hand mirror. The lesson introduces the past perfect tense ('had never travelled', 'had reached') and the use of 'decided', 'invited', and 'excited'. The workbook drills the story fill-in and vocabulary; the grammar workbook rewrites active sentences into the passive voice (present, past, and future passive), answers questions in the passive, and writes dialogues with 'will be + past participle'.

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

Sally's first train ride. 萨莉第一次乘火车旅行。Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party. I decided to take her by train. Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before. She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw. A pretty lady got on the train and sat near Sally. 'Hello, little girl,' she said. Sally did not answer, but stared at her. The lady was wearing a blue dress and a large, fashionable hat. After the train had reached the next station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her hand mirror.

萨莉第一次乘火车旅行。上星期，我四岁的女儿萨莉被邀请去参加一个儿童聚会。我决定带她乘火车去。萨莉非常兴奋，因为她以前从未乘过火车。她坐在窗户旁边，对她看到的一切问这问那。一位漂亮的女士上了火车，坐在萨莉旁边。「你好，小姑娘，」她说。萨莉没有回答，只是盯着她看。那位女士穿着一件蓝连衣裙，戴着一顶时髦的大帽子。火车到达下一站后，那位女士打开她的手提包，取出她的化妆镜。

Question: 问题。Why was Sally excited? 萨莉为什么兴奋？

问题：萨莉为什么兴奋？

New words & expressions 生词和短语

invite /ɪnˈvaɪt/
v. 邀请
decide /dɪˈsaɪd/
v. 决定
excited /ɪkˈsaɪtɪd/
adj. 兴奋的
fashionable /ˈfæʃənable/
adj. 时髦的

Notes on the text 课文注释

past perfect 的用法

过去完成时表示「过去的过去」：She had never travelled on a train before. (她以前从未乘过火车。)

was invited 的用法

「被邀请」用被动语态：Sally was invited to a children's party. 本单元的语法练习正是围绕被动语态展开。

decided to do 的用法

「决定做某事」用 decide + to do：I decided to take her by train.
